Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol V - Paintings (Objects)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=6][u][center][b]Artdew Valley Vol V[/b][/center]
[/u][/size][/color]
[b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Because there's nothing better than covering all your walls with elegant paintings on a whim or simply because you like them—anything goes![/size][/color][/i]
[/b]


[/font][font=Georgia][b][size=4][i]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the fifth of them. This volume focuses on adding 30 paintings that contain different and beautiful pixel art-style objects. [/i][size=4][color=#ffff00](This volume alone adds 30 paintings, for a total of 60 in the two volumes of object paintings, and 150 in total if all five volumes focused on paintings are counted.)[/color][/size][/size]
[/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can get all these paintings at [color=#00ff00]Robin's shop[/color] for a modest price of 400g each.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You will find 6 paintings available per day, on [color=#00ff00]Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays[/color]. During that time, you will be able to obtain all 30 paintings available in this volume.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]All the paintings are small and the same size, so you can handle them more easily.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]


[/size][color=#00ff00][size=4][i][b]That's it, I couldn't wait to get this over with, but here we are!!!!!! I hope you enjoy the mod.[/b][/i][/size][/color]



[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][b]Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000][b]you don't need to ask my permission[/b][/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]

[size=4]-------------------------------------------------------------------
You can support me at [url=https://ko-fi.com/juanpa98ar]Ko-Fi[/url] or [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/juanpa98ar]BuyMeACoffee[/url]!
